# Badge

Small non-interactive status label for counts, states and categories.

`KenosUI.Badge` · Data display

## Use

```jsx

```


## Props (BadgeProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `"solid" \| "subtle" \| "outline" \| "surface" \| "plain"` | Default "subtle". |
| `size` | `"xs" \| "sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | Default "sm". |
| `palette` | `"primary" \| "accent" \| "info" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "error"` | Default "primary". |
